title: Jacques Vallée's photo of a UFO over a lake, with every cow looking at it

tellings.quote: the cows every cow in that picture was looking at the UFO

plain: The UFO researcher Jacques Vallée is said to have a photograph of a UFO over a lake in which every cow in the picture is looking straight at the object. A guest named Joe McMoneagle describes the photo to Michels, repeating it from Vallée. To him the cows' gaze suggests something was really there, since the animals were reacting to it.
